To use your jewellery properly the first time, here are some tips:

Wear It Last: Put your jewellery on after applying perfumes, lotions, or cosmetics to avoid contact with chemicals that could damage it.

Handle With Care: Be gentle when putting it on or taking it off to avoid bending or scratching.

Avoid Water: Our jewellery isn’t fully waterproof, so keep it away from water, especially when swimming or showering.

Store Safely: Use the branded Abbott Lyon presentation box or a soft pouch to store your piece when not in use. This prevents scratches and keeps it looking pristine.
